bbs.config.bbspp.title: BBS++
bbs.config.bbspp.cycle_compact-comment: When enabled, the cycle editors key (~) only switches between the Camera Editor and Replay Editor, skipping the Action Editor
bbs.config.bbspp.chinese_keyframe_names-: When enabled, keyframe track names are displayed in Chinese for easier identification
bbs.config.bbspp.film_auto_game_mode-com: Automatically switch to spectator mode when opening the film editor, and restore the original mode when closing it
bbs.config.bbspp.prevent_negative_keyfra: When enabled, prevents dragging or adding keyframes to a time before 0 seconds (negative time) in the keyframe editor
bbs.config.bbspp.reverse_timeline_scroll: When enabled, reverses wheel-driven timeline direction in the film editor, including Ctrl+wheel cursor movement, Alt+wheel movement for selected keyframes or clips, and Alt+wheel horizontal timeline scrolling.
bbs.config.bbspp.direct_parent_picking-c: When enabled, holding Shift and clicking a model part within the Replay Editor will directly select its parent bone without bringing up the hierarchy menu
bbs.config.bbspp.pose_bone_tree_view-com: When enabled, pose editor bones are indented by the model hierarchy and connected with tree guides. Search results remain flat
bbs.config.bbspp.first_person_bobbing-co: When enabled, restores vanilla walking view bobbing effect when playing a 'First Person Replay'. This effect is a simulated implementation rather than directly reusing the game's native mechanism. Enabling this option will override and disable the original BBS bobbing implementation.
bbs.config.bbspp.new_morphing_panel-comm: When enabled, the morphing panel will use the new dual-column layout. When disabled, it will use the vanilla vertical layout.
bbs.config.bbspp.new_film_library_ui-com: When enabled, the film selection screen will use the new film library layout and interactions. When disabled, it will fully use the original film UI.
bbs.config.bbspp.enable_iris_button-comm: When enabled, displays a quick shader control button in the film editor when Iris mod is installed
bbs.config.bbspp.shader_curve_picker-com: When enabled, adding shader curves in curve clips uses the new picker grouped by shader settings. When disabled, BBS uses the vanilla flat list.
bbs.config.bbspp.world_film_shader_curve: Apply Shader Curves in World Playback
When enabled, film playback in the world through Right Ctrl also applies curve clips for sun, weather, sky color, and Iris shader pack parameters.
bbs.config.bbspp.enable_ui_keyframes_lay: When enabled, if the keyframes editor layout is locked, the width adjustment handle between the left track names and the right curve graph will also be hidden, preventing width adjustment.
bbs.config.bbspp.allow_clip_track_expans: Allow Dragging to Expand Clip Tracks
When enabled, dragging a whole clip beyond the top of the timeline can create additional tracks like original BBS
bbs.config.bbspp.private_bbs_clipboard-c: When enabled, BBS-specific copy data such as replays, keyframes, forms, and transforms is kept inside BBS++ instead of being written to the system clipboard. Normal text, colors, paths, and commands still use the system clipboard.
bbs.config.bbspp.film_alt_wheel_timeline: Sets what Alt plus mouse wheel does in the film editor keyframe view when no keyframes are selected. Selected keyframes still move as usual.
bbs.config.bbspp.item_spray_frustum_cull: When enabled, item spray particles outside the player's view skip item rendering to reduce frame drops with many particles.
bbs.config.bbspp.item_spray_max_render_d: Item spray particles beyond this distance skip rendering. Set to 0 to follow the client view distance automatically.
bbs.config.bbspp.item_spray_max_rendered: Limits how many item spray particles can be drawn per frame. Set to 0 for no limit.
bbs.config.bbspp.item_spray_irlite_shado: When IR Lights shadow casting is enabled, limits how many item spray particles can cast shadows. Set to 0 to disable item spray shadows.
bbs.config.bbspp.gizmo_blockbench_mode-c: When enabled, G/S/R only switch the gizmo display mode (no editing), T cycles through Translate/Scale/Rotate
bbs.config.bbspp.gizmo_t_combined-commen: Only effective when Blockbench Flavor Gizmo is enabled. When on, T cycles: Translate → Scale → Rotate → Combined → …
bbs.config.bbspp.gizmo_keep_original-com: Only effective when Blockbench Flavor Gizmo is enabled. When on, pressing G/S/R a second time runs the original BBS hotkey function instead of restoring the previous mode
bbs.config.personalization.xavin.title: BBS VFX
bbs.config.personalization.xavin.enabled: Master switch for the BBS VFX addon.
bbs.config.vfx.title: VFX
bbs.config.vfx.ae_tracking-comment: Also export an After Effects camera script (.jsx) next to the rendered video.
bbs.config.vfx.glb_export-comment: Also export a binary glTF (.glb) animated camera next to the rendered video, for Blender.
bbspp.ui.forms.editors.aaa_particle.loop: Automatically restart the effect when it finishes
bbspp.ui.forms.editors.aaa_particle.forc: When start and end frames are identical, the effect freezes. Enable this to perfectly fix visual breaking of ribbon/track particles during this freeze
bbspp.ui.forms.editors.aaa_particle.igno: When turned on, particles will ignore all obstructions.Under shaders, there will be slight rendering order anomalies
bbspp.ui.forms.editors.aaa_particle.loop: Start frame of the loop. 0 means no limit; capped at 500 to prevent seek lag
End frame of the loop. 0 means no limit; capped at 500 to prevent seek lag
bbspp.ui.forms.editors.aaa_particle.trig: The button triggers once immediately; keyframes trigger only on an off-to-on edge, so insert an off keyframe between repeated triggers
bbspp.ui.film.library.folder_remove_fail: This folder still contains backup folders or other hidden contents. Please clean it manually before deleting.

bbspp.ui.pose.parameter_brush_tooltip:
Bone Parameter Brush

Save all parameters from the primary selected bone, then click another bone in the list or model viewport to paste them. The brush exits after one use; press Esc to cancel. An orange diamond indicates that the bone has changes in the current pose keyframe
